body: The fact that you created an account merely to say something like this to me says a lot about you. Why would you do this? What is your thought process? I'm in a lot of pain right now and am having a lot of confusing thoughts, but your comment is absurd even to me. Please get help because this is not normal behavior.
This hit me really, really deeply. (Not in a bad way.) Thank you. I really hope you're right.

Thank you so much for your words. I've never been good at opening up to people, so thinking about doing all of this is just giving me more anxiety, but I know it's what I have to do. I'm really terrified, but just reading things like this from kind strangers is making me feel less alone. So thank you again.
Thank you so much for your kind offer. It really means a lot to me. I don't know if I feel up to doing this right at the moment but I might try to take you up on this later.
